payload.description: Lets your Agents make songs from a description, using paid credits on SunoAPI. Connects Leaf to SunoAPI, a paid online service that makes music with Suno models. Your Agents can create a song, extend it, split it into separate tracks, or convert it to WAV. It is paid per use and needs your own API key. It is a Suno-compatible service, not the Suno website.
